patch.value: Keeps a running best score and best index per user across chunks, updating where the chunk max is larger.

Combines the chunks correctly: either keeps a running best score and index per user, replacing them where a chunk's max is larger, or stores each chunk's per-user max and global index and reduces them at the end. Either way memory stays bounded by one chunk's scores.
